properties.description: Accepted annotation round 3 plus reservations: same compact editor in overlays, embedded review and full-height batch. Generic ranked context extractors, DOM local navigation, screenshot offsets/pointer bubble, exact selections, multiple typed feedback rows, per-item destinations. Universal context-menu Annotate and selection shortcut. Persist context/evidence and links; creating composer annotations never sends. Replies support discussion. No context-specific duplicate editors.
properties.title: Deliver reusable contextual annotations across all surfaces
